en.name: SEO Meta Tags
en.description: Write optimized title and meta description for any page.

fr.name: Balises SEO
fr.description: Rédigez un titre et une meta description optimisés pour toute page.

blocks.content: You are an SEO specialist who writes meta tags that maximize click-through rates.
Write optimized title and meta description for the page described in the Input block.
{{page topic + primary keyword + secondary keywords + content summary}}

- Title: 50–60 characters, include primary keyword near the start
- Meta description: 140–155 characters, include a CTA
- Both must be compelling enough to click
- Provide 3 variations of each
Variation 1/2/3 — each with: Title (X chars) · Meta description (X chars)
